title: Positive prose calibration: literal examples, not an AI-pattern blacklist
status: development calibration corpus; transfer efficacy not yet independently established
authority: Writing calibration and historical experiment evidence only. No article authority or permission to transplant content.

source_snapshots.import_rule: Files in sources/ are unmodified copies of existing Git blobs. Their historical protocol prose is evidence, not a replacement for live repository governance.

label_rules.authorship: Record owner-authored, minimally edited owner, model-generated, or unknown separately from detector outcome.
label_rules.editorial: Owner acceptance/rejection and current editorial analysis are separate from Pangram labels.
label_rules.detector: Retain exact named boundary, model/version where recorded, confidence, and whether the evidence is an owner report or a saved result. Never assign a whole-window result to an isolated sentence.
label_rules.alignment: A same-topic pair is not necessarily a same-thought pair. Preserve semantic differences explicitly.
label_rules.independence: Examples from one source family, campaign, or factorial are correlated. This corpus is development material, not a held-out accuracy benchmark.
label_rules.facts: Historical health, spiritual and relationship claims in examples are not freshly fact-checked recommendations. Do not export their claims into another article.

families.name: When adult language becomes a symptom inventory
Inner speech, bodily attention and timing uncertainty
Adult-child distrust, normalization and null controls
Concrete heart-loop instructions and owner-source recovery
Owner reauthoring of promises and realistic boundaries
Honesty advice grounded in an actual complication
Relationship spirit and the sealed-room causal image
Research prose, taxonomy and bridge interactions

cases.use: Literal model-before and owner-after; preserve the changed escape-versus-throwing-a-fit example in the alignment note.
cases.positive_move: Turn the symptom inventory into something unfolding while the reader tries to speak lovingly.
cases.limit: The owner endpoint was Human/low in the local report; this is not a robust-Human certification of the assembled opening.

cases.use: Read both complete three-paragraph realizations and the recorded paragraph-2/paragraph-3 combinations.
cases.positive_move: Let language use lead to the reader's actual comfort or attention, rather than enumerate every available modality and then explain the epistemology.
cases.limit: The combined owner edits passed where either alone did not. The example inventory changes; neither exact semantic identity nor a one-phrase cause is established.

cases.use: Compare probes 1 and 2 at the immutable article-side ladder path in the recovery manifest.
cases.positive_move: Say what happened to jaw and stomach directly instead of giving neighboring body cues separate rhetorical beats.
cases.limit: The local two-paragraph boundary changed AI/medium to Human/medium. No isolated body-cue test or universal rule was established.

cases.use: Compare probes 4 and 5 in the article-side ladder; record exactly the deleted later-analysis instruction.
cases.positive_move: Proceed to the actual relational event without first announcing an analysis stage.
cases.limit: This does not prohibit temporal bridges or all explicit instructions. It is a local boundary comparison.

cases.use: Read the complete owner-final three paragraphs as the communication benchmark, not a phrase bank.
cases.positive_move: Appreciate noticing with the reader, reduce pressure, then state a supported disagreement with the self-created-problems frame.
cases.limit: The final endpoint adds authorial stance. Do not call the whole before/after a clean style-only pair or infer emoji causality.

cases.use: Read failed model text and successful model transfer literally; do not relabel the latter as Joel-authored.
cases.positive_move: State use, felt effect and the remaining deeper difficulty without performing the writer's responsible interpretive position.
cases.limit: Both versions retain similar overall progression and examples. This is a counterexample to requiring a wholly different abstract outline for every successful repair.

cases.use: Compare the raw owner paragraph with its minimally normalized published-register version.
cases.positive_move: Keep the unresolved exchange between adult promises and the child's judgment of the adult's record while repairing readability.
cases.limit: Both were owner-reported Human/medium. Typos, lowercase and rough transcription are not required Human signals.

cases.use: Compare the model's trust paragraph and surrounding theory with the owner paragraph; explicitly track the extra roles/fallback material in the larger model boundary.
cases.positive_move: Allow the specific distrust to remain unresolved instead of converting it immediately into named roles and a treatment sequence.
cases.limit: These complete test boundaries are not semantically identical. Do not present this as a controlled style-only flip.

cases.use: Compare complete boundaries and then their different final practice paragraphs.
cases.positive_move: Give the person concrete placement, a source-grounded reason and the actual action rather than gently narrate readiness and a hypothetical attempt.
cases.limit: The owner version adds hand placement and rationale; the model version contains love-source and softening functions absent from the owner diagnostic. These are different semantic subsets. Historical claims are not endorsed here.

cases.use: Compare the R8D and R8E no-self/therapy regions using exact candidate sources, not just the terminal R8F sentence.
cases.positive_move: Carry the newly emerging ability to say no across the two situations; let the actual difficulty of objecting do the work of the separate conclusions.
cases.limit: Regional editorial comparison; no claim that every deleted sentence was independently detector-causal.

cases.use: Recover all thirteen candidate records, their instructions, forecasts and outcome files. Preserve broad, regional and residual phases and the flat intermediate results.
cases.positive_move: Use external correction to change the realization, retain demonstrated progress, and let edit scope follow actual localization.
cases.limit: The final 39-word operation is not the whole method. Completing this historical campaign does not certify new one-shot generation or a universal classifier.

cases.use: Read the literal model core and Joel's replacement, including its newly added thought.
cases.positive_move: Use the reader's own time spent changing as the reason to assess promises realistically, and connect boundaries with supporting the other person.
cases.limit: Mutual uncertainty, growth timescale and supportive boundaries are new owner cognition. Not an aligned style-only demonstration; current owner prose remains locked.

cases.use: Compare the generic radical-honesty disclaimer with the owner's actual countercase; inspect the advice sentences retained verbatim afterward.
cases.positive_move: Acknowledge the author's own damaging excess before asking the couple to agree about honesty.
cases.limit: The retained advice occurred in an AI window and later in a Human/high section. It cannot be declared intrinsically AI from the first window. No invented autobiography is permitted.

cases.use: Read the two reported red windows beside the complete owner-final section; track unchanged myth sentences and the typo correction.
cases.positive_move: Make the institutional mechanism intelligible through the sealed-room/fresh-air/mold relation; do not merely announce that relationships bear too much pressure.
cases.limit: This authorial image and spiritual mechanism are not transplantable content. Lists, direct counsel and neat sentences survive in the successful section.

cases.use: Compare the two near-identical owner versions, then separately inspect the earlier model version with its content differences.
cases.positive_move: Ask for the reader's recognition where shared curiosity is actually being invited.
cases.limit: Both near-identical versions were Human. The question is not a Human/AI switch rule; the older model comparison is not a same-thought minimal pair.

cases.use: Read every complete cell; compare with the normalized owner baseline.
cases.outcomes: A1 Human 1.0; A2 Human 1.0; A3 Human 1.0 in the saved Pangram 4 results.
cases.limit: Adding explanatory aftercare, equalizing sentences, or combining them did not cause a detector regression here. This does not make unnecessary aftercare editorially desirable.

cases.outcomes: B1 and B2 Human; B3 Mixed, AI fraction 0.132098034; B4 and B5 Human.
cases.use: Compare the same two added jobs singly, together, and with either realization changed.
cases.limit: Five correlated cells, not five independent case successes. Clinical source content is historical calibration only.

cases.outcomes: C1 and C7 AI 1.0; C2 Mixed; C3, C4, C5 and C6 Human 1.0.
cases.positive_move: Let the concrete limitation remain understandable instead of compressing it into a polished cross-domain synthesis.
cases.limit: Paragraph packing, compression and explicit linkage were not independently sufficient. The earlier v1 C1 recorded file hash is incomplete; use the full hash in controls-results.json and verify actual bytes.

cases.use: Compare the exact R14 third paragraph with the earlier Human forecast and later explanation.
cases.limit: Owner reported AI for the paragraphs under discussion; complete submission details/confidence are not recovered. Post-result explanation is not independent proof of a detector cause.

cases.use: Inspect the exact R15 semantic shifts and the first admission audit's rationalizations.
cases.limit: R15 was not measured by Pangram in this lane. Do not manufacture an AI detector label or treat a later self-audit as an independent judge.

activation.selection: Retrieve by the actual rhetorical/semantic problem. Do not dump this complete archive into every writing context.
activation.outcome_check: The next new candidate still needs source fidelity and external owner/detector evidence under the active article contract. Corpus assembly is not generation validation.
